entry.title: Germany eInvoice – Issue with ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3) Conversion in Background Process
entry.content:
Hello Team,

We would like to inform you about an issue identified in the Germany eInvoice process related to the ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3) conversion.

As part of the standard process, once the PDF is successfully uploaded to the invoice and the Customer button is clicked in EDOC_COCKPIT, the system should automatically perform the conversion to ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3 format) in the background. Subsequently, the invoice should be sent to the customer via email in ZUGFeRD format.

However, we have observed that the conversion to ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3 format) is currently not being triggered in the background as expected.


--- Steps to Reproduce ---

  1. Goto EDOC_COCKPIT and eDocument is created first as xml (XRechnung format) file.
  2. Validation happens when we click on "Submit".
  3. Next it comes back as "File validated".
  4. At this point PDF should be uploaded to this eDocument (call of class- UPLOAD_FILE_TO_EDOC method of the CL_EDOC_API_FILE class). PDF is still done by SmartForms (as standard PDF invoices in old process).
  5. When we upload PDF successfully, invoice can be sent to Customer via email using button "Customer".
  6. This is when conversion to ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3 file) happens in the background (embedding xml to PDF).

However, we have observed that the conversion to ZUGFeRD (PDF/A-3 format-XML embedded in PDF) is currently not being triggered in the background as expected.

entry.title: Transfer Posting MvT 321 without UD via MIGO
entry.content:
Dear SAP QM Team,

We need your expert clarification regarding the behavior of Movement Type 321 (Quality Inspection Stock to Unrestricted Use) in our SAP system for all materials were inspection type is active.

Scenario

  • Material is configured with Inspection Type 04 (GR from Production).
  • Upon Goods Receipt from Process Order:
    • Stock is posted to Quality Inspection (QI) stock.
    • Inspection Lot is generated automatically.
  • The Inspection Lot status remains:
    REL CALC SPRQ
    indicating that the inspection is still active and no Usage Decision has been made.

Observation

Despite the inspection lot being open, the system allows users to execute MIGO with Movement Type 321 and transfer stock directly from QI to Unrestricted Use without:

  • Result Recording (QA32/QE51N)
  • Usage Decision (QA11/QA32)

As a result:

  • Inventory moves to Unrestricted Use.
  • The inspection lot remains open in REL status.
  • This creates a compliance issue as inspected stock can be used before completion of the QM process.

Clarifications Required

  1. Is this standard SAP behavior for Movement Type 321?
  2. What configuration settings control whether 321 movements are permitted when an open inspection lot exists?
  3. Are there any QM-specific settings in:
    • Material Master (QM View)
    • Inspection Type 04
    • Movement Type 321 (OMJJ)
    • Inspection Lot Origin settings that should prevent this stock transfer?
  4. What is the SAP-recommended approach to ensure stock cannot be moved from QI to Unrestricted Use while an active inspection lot exists?

We would appreciate your guidance on the exact controls and configuration points that govern this behavior.
